wholePhysicalScope: Named 31-point OpenStreetMap museum outline and the preserved pink pavilion elevations.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the salmon museum envelope, main entrance arch, corner pavilions, rear galleries and glass roof lights. Near levels resolve arch moldings, paired columns, niches and window grids.
limitations: The Egyptian Museum on Tahrir Square is represented in May 2019. The opening depth, roof lights, flank details and extent of some roof alterations are approximate. The 2008 front photograph informs the surviving entrance stonework.

Fine carvings and inscriptions are represented by simplified relief and plaques. The original Terrarium samples are preserved, and the steep local source readings cover some lower side elevations in the terrain view.
